connect.note: Green ticks marked Checks itself turn on when Locus can really see the account. The others are ticked by our team once we have looked.

team.label: Give us access
clicks: 1. In Shopify admin open Settings > Domains and copy your store address that ends in .myshopify.com.
2. Open Settings > Users > Security. Under Collaborators, copy the Collaborator request code (if your store has one).
3. Paste both below and press Save.
4. We send the request from our Shopify Partner account. Shopify emails you, you press Approve (Settings > Users > Collaborators).

inputs.label: Collaborator request code (if you have one)

team.note: Shopify does not let anyone send this request automatically, so a person on our team sends it by hand, usually the same day.

app.label: Install the Locus app
clicks: 1. Press Install. Shopify opens your admin and asks you to approve the app.
2. Approve it. This box ticks itself.

platforms.title: Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
platforms.why: Your ad results, every ad and the audiences.

team.label: Give us access
clicks: 1. Open business.facebook.com/settings and pick your business.
2. Users > Partners > Add > "Give a partner access to your assets".
3. Paste our Business ID and press Next.
4. Tick every asset and give each Full control: ad accounts, Pages, pixels and datasets, the Instagram account and catalogs. Save.
team.note: Locus does not check the Instagram account yet. Your team looks at it before the first ad.

app.label: Locus reads your ads
app.note: Nothing to do. This ticks itself.

platforms.title: Google Ads
platforms.why: Search and shopping ads, side by side with Meta.

team.label: Give us access
clicks: 1. Type your Google Ads customer ID below (10 digits, top right in Google Ads). We send the request.
2. In Google Ads open Admin > Access and security > Managers and press Accept on the Mobius Digital request.

app.label: Locus reads your ads
app.note: Nothing to do. This ticks itself.

platforms.title: Google Analytics
platforms.why: How people move through your website.

team.label: Give us access
clicks: 1. Open analytics.google.com and pick your website.
2. Admin (the gear, bottom left) > Property access management.
3. Press +, Add users, add our email, choose Administrator, press Add.

app.label: Locus reads it
app.note: Nothing to do. This ticks itself.

platforms.title: Google Search Console
platforms.why: What people search before they find you.

team.label: Give us access
clicks: 1. Open search.google.com/search-console and pick your website.
2. Settings > Users and permissions > Add user.
3. Add our email with Full permission.

app.label: Locus reads it
app.note: Nothing to do. This ticks itself.

platforms.title: Microsoft Clarity
platforms.why: Recordings of real visits, so we see where people get stuck.

team.label: Give us access
clicks: 1. Open clarity.microsoft.com and your project. No Clarity yet? Install the free Microsoft Clarity app from the Shopify App Store first.
2. Settings > Team > Add team member.
3. Add our email as Admin.

app.label: Locus reads it
app.note: Nothing to do. Our team connects it once we have access.

platforms.title: Klaviyo (or your email tool)
platforms.why: Emails and texts, and what they sell.

team.label: Give us access
clicks: 1. In Klaviyo click your name (bottom left) > Settings > Users > Add new user.
2. Add our email as Admin.

app.label: Locus reads it
app.note: Nothing to do. This ticks itself.

platforms.title: TikTok (if you use it)
platforms.why: TikTok ads next to the others.

team.label: Give us access
clicks: 1. Open business.tiktok.com and your Business Center.
2. Partners > Add partner > paste our Business Center ID.
3. Share your ad account with Admin access.

app.label: Locus reads your ads
app.note: Nothing to do. This ticks itself.

platforms.title: Triple Whale
platforms.why: One honest count of which ad made each sale.

team.label: Give us access
clicks: 1. Open Triple Whale > Settings > Users and press Invite.
2. Add our email as Admin.
3. Type your store address below.

app.label: Locus reads it
app.note: Nothing to do. This ticks itself.

questions.text: What does your product solve, and why do people buy it?
questions.hint: The problem it fixes, in the words your customers use.

questions.text: What makes you different from the other options a customer has?
questions.hint: Why someone picks you over the brand next to you.

questions.text: What must we never say, and what must we always say? Include any claims you legally cannot make.
questions.hint: Words to avoid, words to always use, claims you cannot make.

questions.text: Which products should we push, and which should we leave alone?
questions.hint: Best margin, best stock, anything running low.

questions.text: Which offers are we allowed to run, and how deep can a discount go?
questions.hint: Bundles, free gifts, free shipping, the most off you would ever give.
questions.draft: Bundles of a belt and a hat, and free shipping over $75. The website shows 20% off at most.

questions.text: What cost per sale would you be happy with?
questions.hint: A rough number is fine. We agree the real goal on the call.

questions.text: What would make the next 90 days a success for you?
questions.hint: One or two things you would be glad to see.

questions.text: What have you tried in ads that did not work?
questions.hint: Ads, offers or agencies. It saves us repeating it.

questions.text: Can we use customer photos, reviews and creator videos in ads? Any limits?
questions.hint: Yes, no, or yes with a rule.

questions.text: Who says yes to an ad on your side, and how fast?
questions.hint: A name and how long a yes usually takes.

answers.solves: Belts that stretch with your swing and stay comfortable for 18 holes. People buy them because a normal belt digs in by the back nine.
answers.uvp: Made for golf first, with a buckle that does not show a hole pattern. Most belts in our price range are fashion belts.
answers.dos_donts: Never say waterproof. Always say stretch, not elastic. No claims about back pain.
answers.push_products: The new tour belts and the gift sets. Leave the travel belt alone, stock is low.
answers.success_90: A profitable Black Friday and a steady $60k month in January.
